text_to_image_prompt: One compact tropical oceanfront flat-roof white villa to the right of a single long rectangular cyan infinity pool. Ocean to left; circular sunken lounge with cream cushions and round fire bowl at far short end; narrow stone paths; straight floating wood exterior stair at near end of villa; small wooden bar with three wicker stools at near-right. Teak roof has white daybed, brass telescope, slim dark/glass railings. No people, second pool or extra wings. Landscape sheet with TWO top-down 90-degree orthographic plans SIDE BY SIDE, site plan left and rooftop right at identical scale and orientation. Both villa footprints are long narrow vertical rectangles. Site has pool left, villa right, round lounge at top, stair and bar bottom-right; opaque pale fill leaves interior unspecified. Roof has daybed top-left, telescope top-right and stair landing bottom-right, no pool. Fine dark outlines, pale natural material colors, white background, no text or dimensions. Concept set design reference, not measured construction documentation.
original_prompt: Revise this architectural plan sheet for STRICT CONSISTENCY. Keep the site's upper plan design, but lay out TWO diagrams SIDE BY SIDE, on a landscape white sheet: LEFT the full site plan seen in this image; RIGHT the roof plan. BOTH use the SAME scale, SAME north/up orientation, SAME exact long narrow vertical rectangular villa footprint proportions; align rooftop plan vertically with villa rectangle in left plan. The roof's long axis must run vertically, not horizontally. Roof contains one small white cushioned daybed toward top-left, brass telescope toward top-right, plants and slim glass railing, stair landing at bottom-right connected to the same straight stair drawn at the bottom end of the left villa. No roof pool. Preserve main site: pool left, villa right, circular firepit lounge top end, bar with three stools bottom-right. Architectural top-down 90 degree plan, no perspective. Soft natural colors, crisp edges, white margins, no text, numbers, dimensions. Concept reference.
